description.value:
Area 10-foot burst

Duration as Borrowed Grief

Traits Wailing Debt

You may aim Borrowed Grief at a location within range instead of at a creature. It affects every creature in a 10-foot burst centred on that point, allies included. Each affected creature attempts the save Borrowed Grief normally calls for. You are not affected by your own casting, but you see what they see.

cinderfall.incomplete: Retargets an existing single-target spell (Borrowed Grief) into an area spell -- a structural change, not a numeric one. The real ItemAlteration property enum (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/item-alteration/handlers.ts:106-1003) is closed and explicit (ac-bonus, area-size, badge-max, badge-value, check-penalty, damage-dice-faces, damage-dice-number, damage-type, defense-passive, dex-cap, focus-point-cost, hp-max, material-type, pd-recovery-dc, persistent-damage, range-increment, range-max, frequency-max, frequency-per, other-tags, runes-potency, runes-resilient, runes-striking, speed-penalty) -- there is no target-type or area-type property, confirmed by direct read of the file (no such case exists). Widen Spell (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/shared-class-feats/level-1/widen-spell.json) only ever scales an area that already exists via area-size; Borrowed Grief has no area field to scale in the first place.
